environment_detail: WSL2 distribution Ubuntu-24.04 with WSLg, on a Windows 11 host (10.0.26300.9974): WSL 3.0.5.0, WSLg 1.0.79, Microsoft WSL2 kernel 6.18.58.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2. This is a Linux userland in WSL2's lightweight utility VM, not a bare-metal install and not a full distribution boot with a desktop session (the window captures show the client area only, no title bar or window decorations). The GTK application normally talks to the WSLg Wayland compositor (default GDK display class: GdkWaylandDisplay, DISPLAY=:0 and WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0 both set); XWayland is available for X11 clients. Resources visible in the VM: 8 logical CPUs (Intel Core i5-8300H @ 2.30GHz host), 20003 MB of memory. Build and run happen in the home folder of the distribution (~/loomora-build), the repository being read through /mnt/h.
kernel: 6.18.58.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 (uname -r); a vendor kernel, so the kernel part of the Linux end-of-life rule of loomora_is_eol is evaluated on 6.18, which the backend does not treat as end of life
gtk_version: 3.24.41 (pkg-config gtk+-3.0; libgtk-3-0t64 3.24.41-4ubuntu1.3); gtkmm-3.0 3.24.9 (glibmm 2.66.7, libsigc++ 2.12.1) used by the Linux Modern UI since 2026-11-14; GTK 4.14.5 with gtkmm-4.0 4.10.0 (glibmm 2.68, libsigc++ 3.6.0) installed for the optional GTK 4 build
compiler: gcc 13.3.0 (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1), cmake 3.31.12, ninja 1.11.1 (meson 1.3.2 was the build system of the Linux Modern UI until 2026-11-14, ADR 0006)
release_date_source: distro-info-data (/usr/share/distro-info/ubuntu.csv in the distribution): release 2024-04-25 for 24.04 LTS; age_years = days from that date to the trial date 2026-11-12 divided by 365.25
